CS 413 / CS 591

Digital Forensics

  • Undergraduate and graduate
  • 3 credits

Offered: Fall 2024, Fall 2023

This course develops the mindset and foundational skills needed to investigate digital incidents. It covers forensic methods for desktop and mobile systems, emphasizing the relationship between technical evidence and legal considerations.

Selected Topics

  • Confidentiality, integrity, and availability
  • Digital investigation methods and legal considerations
  • Digital evidence acquisition and media analysis
  • Forensic tools for desktop and mobile platforms

Learning Objectives

  • Explain core digital forensic methods and relevant legal concerns.
  • Acquire and analyze basic digital media evidence in a controlled setting.

Coursework & Projects

Hands-on assignments and labs complement a practical investigation project and presentation. Quizzes and exams assess understanding of the methods.
